propositions: CompletionAgentStep.run catches only UnretryableOutputError, so LLMRunnerError from step-budget exhaustion never enters bounded recovery and propagates unhandled

interpret_failure raises LLMRunnerError for budget exhaustion but that type is a strict ancestor of UnretryableOutputError, making budget stops indistinguishable from other LLMRunnerError cases without shape sniffing
Bounded recovery must become reachable for budget exhaustion to isolate each criterion in fresh agentic history and converge with tool-free structured finalizer

A new typed exception LLMBudgetExhaustedError(LLMRunnerError) in errors.py and raised from interpret_failure's budget branch enables pure type-based routing without message or diagnostic-shape inspection
Extending CompletionAgentStep.run's except clause to catch LLMBudgetExhaustedError and route to _recover preserves the original budget diagnostic on failure_diagnostic before recovery
Non-budget LLMRunnerError must still propagate unchanged, and existing UnretryableOutputError truncation path must keep exact current behaviour
